parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spills and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move during operation.

parts.name: Button (Top Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top handle or knob on the lid, made of heat-resistant Bakelite plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift the lid safely without burning their hands.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the lid and does not move independently.

parts.name: Button (Side Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is a side handle attached to the pot body, made of heat-resistant Bakelite plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting or moving the pot safely.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the pot body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum, cylindrical in shape with a flat base.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking and distributes heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the main structural component of the pot.
